title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 10 August 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 09 August 2026 Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Kandy, Nuwara-Eliya, Galle and Matara districts. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara, Batticaloa and Mullaitivu districts after 2.00 p.m. Several spells of showers may occur in North-western province. Strong winds of about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over North-central, North-western, Central and Southern provinces and Trincomalee District. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
